chapter_title: The Snake and the Mirror & A Slumber Did My Spirit Seal
summary: Unit 5 explores inclusivity and sportsmanship through an interview with pioneering Paralympic medalist Dr. Deepa Malik and David Roth's poem 'Nine Gold Medals'. Deepa Malik's life demonstrates how mental fortitude transforms physical adversity into world-record athletic achievements. Roth's poem celebrates empathy at the Special Olympics, where athletes choose solidarity over individual victory.
